title: fab0 ledger entry, schema 2 (runs/<project>/<run>/ledger/<step>[-<unit>]-<attempt>[-gate].yaml in the run store)
description: One attempt of a step, or one gate decision on it: a create-only fact in the run store, written by the engine.

executor.description: What made the attempt. `person`: a person's edit of the outputs on the unit's review pull request, which `apply` records.

actor.description: The tracker user who ran it.

branch.description: The branch the attempt was made on.

heads.description: Per repository, the commit the attempt left its branch at, when the branch has commits its parent lacks. The unit is done once these are in the branch it merges into.

base.description: The parent branch and the commit the inputs were read at.

started.description: When the attempt or the gate decision was handed out, UTC (RFC 3339, whole seconds). Left out by engines before times were kept.

ended.description: When it was recorded, UTC. Written with `started`.

into.description: The branch the gate merges into.

edited.description: A person's attempt: the commit on the unit's review branch it was read from, and the review pull request.

data.description: The return's structured `data`, which later steps read as `{<step>.<field>}`.

rework.description: Why this attempt was made, when it isn't the first: `stale`, `missing`, `verify`, `rejected`, `conflict`, `checks`.
